what: Verbatim excerpts (not the whole article) that carry the SOURCE LABEL of Akrami et al.'s 15 vs 3 GI result; the held abstract says only 'gastrointestinal symptom'.

retrieved.via: PubMed Central full text (PubMed MCP get_full_text_article, PMC8650300)
retrieved.note: the PMC text drops the italic P before '= 0.002'; excerpts are kept exactly as served

excerpts.text: In colchicine group, it was found that at the end of the enrollment, 15 (12.5%) patients had a history of gastrointestinal adverse effects caused by colchicine use in compare with 3 (2.5%) in placebo group (diarrhea,= 0.002).
In our study, out of 15 patients that developed diarrhea, two patients left the study due to drug intolerance.
In placebo group three patients had diarrhea that was significantly lower than study group.
